column1: # SHIPPED-LIBRARY MANIFEST — the declared half of the population of record (B-10).
# Read by tools/shipped_libraries.py, which walks the built bundle and joins it
# to this file. Format: <identity><TAB><deps record><TAB><note>, where identity
# is the framework directory name, or the file's basename for a plain dylib or
# COVERAGE IS DECLARED HERE, NEVER INFERRED FROM A NAME MATCH. Name matching got
# the count wrong four times in three days, in both directions: libsharpyuv looked
# unrecorded and ships with the webp formula; libharfbuzz looked recorded and the
# record describes a VENDORED 8.4.0 while the artifact ships Homebrew's 12.2.0.
# "Covered" means a person wrote the row and a reviewer read it.
# STATE, measured 2026-09-12 against the 09-09 staged bundle: the artifact holds
# 161 third-party Mach-O binaries (34 dylibs + 45 Qt frameworks + 82 Qt plugins).
# 142 are declared below. NINETEEN ARE NOT, and they are deliberately absent
# rather than guessed: they need four licence elections (graphite2, dbus, gettext,
# xz) and one `reuse download LGPL-2.1-only` for glib's text, and this desk
# records elections, it does not make them. tools/shipped_libraries.py --check
# names them and exits non-zero until they land.
# THE 82 PLUGINS WERE IN NO PRIOR COUNT AT ALL. Every earlier instrument stopped
# at Contents/Frameworks; the plugin tree under Contents/PlugIns/ was invisible to
# all of them, which is how three instruments could report 19, 9 and 63 for the
# same artifact and none be describing it.
# ---- Qt frameworks and the libraries macdeployqt pulled in with them ----
